headline: Labor unrest: More garment factories shut in Gazipur, Savar, Ashulia
summary: Dozens of factories declared holidays or saw work stoppages as workers attempted to block highways in Gazipur.
details: More garment factories in Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia declared holidays or saw work stoppages today amid ongoing labor unrest in the industrial areas.
In Gazipur, 15 additional factories declared a general holiday. A group of 30 to 40 workers attempted to block the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway near Bhogra Bypass, where they threw bricks and stones.
Police reached the spot and dispersed the workers. Traffic movement on the highway remained normal, though authorities warned the situation could change.
In Savar and Ashulia, four factories were closed and workers at more than 15 other factories stopped working, according to industrial police.
The unrest follows a massive wave of closures on Monday, when 150 factories were shut down amid workers' protests.
While some factories continue to operate and report stable wages, others have seen walkouts in areas like Narsinghpur in Ashulia.
caption:
Dozens of garment factories shut down as labor unrest spreads across Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia.

More garment factories in Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia declared holidays or saw work stoppages today amid ongoing labor unrest in the industrial areas.

In Gazipur, 15 additional factories declared a general holiday. A group of 30 to 40 workers attempted to block the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway near Bhogra Bypass, where they threw bricks and stones.

Police reached the spot and dispersed the workers. Traffic movement on the highway remained normal, though authorities warned the situation could change.

In Savar and Ashulia, four factories were closed and workers at more than 15 other factories stopped working, according to industrial police.

The unrest follows a massive wave of closures on Monday, when 150 factories were shut down amid workers' protests.

While some factories continue to operate and report stable wages, others have seen walkouts in areas like Narsinghpur in Ashulia.

headline: The Big Show ends: Glenn Maxwell retires from international cricket
summary: The Australian all-rounder, one of only two players to score five T20I centuries, steps away from the international stage.
details: Australian all-rounder Glenn Maxwell has announced his retirement from international cricket and domestic red-ball games for Victoria. The 38-year-old revealed the decision on The Final Word podcast on Tuesday.
caption:
One of the most talented batters of his generation, 'The Big Show' has called time on his international career.

Australian all-rounder Glenn Maxwell has announced his retirement from international cricket and domestic red-ball games for Victoria. The 38-year-old revealed the decision on The Final Word podcast on Tuesday.
